dataset_name: AquaGuard AI ornamental-fish knowledge base (source-reviewed draft)
purpose: Seed data for research prototype; not a substitute for species-specific expert advice or fish-welfare decisions.

interpretation_policy.temperature_and_ph: Published general aquarium-maintenance range, not lethal boundary and not necessarily the optimum for every strain or life stage.
interpretation_policy.optimal_ranges: Null unless directly supported by a source. Do not infer an optimum from the full maintenance range.
interpretation_policy.tds: Null because the selected species profiles report hardness (dGH), not validated species-specific TDS limits. TDS must not be inferred directly from dGH.
interpretation_policy.hardness: Stored separately as general hardness in degrees dGH; it is not the same as TDS.
interpretation_policy.tank_size: Use the profile's recommended aquarium base dimensions and group/social needs. Reference volumes are example tank volumes, not per-fish litres and not a capacity algorithm.
interpretation_policy.missing_compatibility: An absent pair rule means UNKNOWN/NOT ASSESSED, not compatible.
interpretation_policy.hard_constraints: Published care ranges can be adopted as conservative planning boundaries only if this policy is documented. They should not be described as lethal thresholds without evidence.
interpretation_policy.heuristics: Spatial zones and proposed livebearer sex ratios are project starting heuristics and require domain-expert review.
interpretation_policy.numeric_aggression: Not populated as validated numeric labels because profiles do not supply a consistent calibrated 1-10 aggression scale. Build a scoring rubric and get independent review before use.

candidate_compatibility_rules.rationale: Betta profile advises tankmates be chosen carefully; guppy profile warns against known fin-nippers. This combination needs strain/finnage/individual review; sources do not prove every pairing is incompatible.
Angelfish may eat small fish, including tetras; evaluate adult angelfish size relative to neon tetras. Do not treat this as a universal absolute rule without a defined conservative policy.
Large angelfish may eat small tankmates; guppy finnage/size may affect suitability. Pair needs specific review.

implementation_notes: Do not let an empty compatibility_rules array pass a pair automatically; treat it as unknown and apply a clear unknown-policy.
Update the application to handle null tds_ppm and null optimal values. Do not run numeric fuzzy membership calculations with null values.
For initial FIS testing, either omit TDS as an input pending validation or use an explicitly labelled engineering placeholder and exclude those results from biological-validity claims.
Use expert-reviewed labels for the final benchmark dataset, and freeze labels before evaluating code.
Each source URL was checked on the dataset creation date; re-check the links and source contents before final dissertation submission.
